result.title: Beckmann World Models: Direct Terminal-Map Learning for One-Step Action-Conditioned Prediction
result.summary: Action-conditioned world models support planning and policy evaluation by predicting future states. However, learning an accurate one-step predictor can require substantial training computation. We introduce Beckmann World Models (BWM), which learn a direct map from noise, visual history, and actions to future frames without a pretrained generative teacher. We adapt the terminal-map conservation law of Beckmann Transport Models to action-conditioned video prediction, training directly from noise-data pairs without conditional populations of generated samples required by DriftWorld. However, transport consistency on interpolated inputs does not ensure accurate prediction from the pure noise used at inference. We address this gap with endpoint-aligned training that directly supervises the source prediction, emphasizes motion and spatial structure, and teaches recovery from generated histories. All components train the same map and retain one network call per future chunk. On PushT and Robomimic Can, the final model reduces 64-frame prediction MSE by 68% and 57%, respectively, relative to same-backbone regression baseline. For policy evaluation, BWM achieves the lowest mean IoU error among the evaluated models, 0.0100, at 24.8 ms per four-frame PushT prediction. On Robomimic Can, the BWM stage trained with motion supervision and generated histories achieves 3.3 times higher throughput and 78% lower peak memory than local one-step DriftWorld. In a latent-space extension to RT-1 and Bridge-V2, equal-update controls show that feature supervision under generated histories improves perceptual prediction. These findings show how terminal-map learning can combine efficient training with accurate one-step visual prediction.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Beckmann World Models，将 Beckmann 传输模型的终端映射推广到动作条件视频预测，学习从噪声、视觉历史与动作直接一步生成未来帧，并以端点对齐训练、运动与空间结构监督及自生成历史恢复训练弥补纯噪声输入下的精度缺口，在 PushT、Robomimic Can 上验证精度、吞吐与显存优势。
AI.relevance_reason: 其单步「噪声→未来帧」映射、对源预测的端点监督以及在自生成历史上训练，可能为 LVR 的一步 latent 状态生成、视觉细节保留与轨迹式监督提供可核查线索；文中的 latent 特征监督扩展也值得留意，但任务本身是视频/世界模型预测而非 VLM 推理。
